name: Heibon na Oku-san wa Suki Desu ka? ~Majime na Shufu o Ecchi-zuke ni Shichaou!~
original_name: 平凡な奥さんは好きですか?～真面目な主婦をエッチ漬けにしちゃおう!～
source:
Sakagami Mamoru is a university student who is living alone because his parents traveled abroad for work. His neighbor, Tamura Chihaya is a meek and timid housewife with a young daughter.

Since the husband is always busy with work and comes home late, Mamoru, despite going to classes and working part-time job everyday, looks after Chihaya's daughter when she goes to work due to her family's dire financial situation.

Mamoru is secretly in love with Chihaya and thought he would never convey this feeling to her. However, one incident leads them to commit a mistake which will change their relationship forever.
translation:
坂上守是一名獨居的大學生，父母因為工作去了海外。鄰居田村千早是一位溫順而膽怯的家庭主婦，還有一個年幼的女兒。

千早的丈夫總是忙於工作，很晚才回家。家中經濟拮据，千早不得不外出打工；守雖然每天既要上課又要打工，仍會在她工作時幫忙照看女兒。

守一直暗戀千早，卻以為自己永遠不會將這份感情說出口。然而，一場意外令兩人犯下錯誤，也從此徹底改變了他們之間的關係。
